segments.oily: Oily skin draws warnings from several reviewers, who say the formula is too rich or heavy and not well suited to oily skin, or left their skin looking oilier the next day when used at night; one reviewer disagrees and recommends it for oily or combination-dehydrated skin.
segments.dry: Dry skin is the most consistently recommended segment: reviewers report deep, lasting hydration, improved plumpness and elasticity, and no irritation, including several who describe their skin as dry and sensitive together; one dissenting reviewer found the hydration too light and quick-absorbing for her dry skin and suggests layering a richer moisturizer after.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, several describing it as combination-dehydrated or seasonally oily-in-summer/dry-in-winter, generally report firmer, more elastic, better hydrated skin; one found it too hydrating to wear comfortably under makeup, and another found it left her oilier the next day when used at night.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and 'super sensitive' skin is heavily represented and mostly positive, with many reviewers reporting no irritation, burning, or blemishes even on skin that reacts to most products; dissent exists, including one reviewer whose skin barrier was acutely damaged with a hypersensitive allergic reaction (though a family member had no reaction to the same product), and another whose sensitive skin became itchy when used two days in a row.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to mid-50s report firmer, more plump skin with visibly reduced forehead lines, marionette lines, neck lines, and lines around the mouth after consistent use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, including several in their late 40s and 50s, report visibly firmer, plumper skin with reduced forehead lines, marionette lines, and lines around the mouth after weeks of consistent use. Dissent is common too: several reviewers say they felt no dramatic collagen or wrinkle-reduction effect and suggest dermatologist treatments are more effective for firmness than any topical product.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe strong, lasting hydration, with several dry-skinned reviewers specifically saying it relieved deep or flaky dryness without needing much else layered on top. Dissent: one reviewer says the product dried her skin out badly enough to trigger a breakout, and another with dry skin found the hydration too light and fast-absorbing to be sufficient on its own.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or rosacea-prone skin, including one who applies it specifically to calm redness and heated skin, report it soothes flushing with no irritation; one dissenting reviewer says her face sometimes feels hot and slightly tingly and suggests other soothing pads may work better when skin is already irritated.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports an acute allergic reaction that left her skin barrier damaged and hypersensitive, though she notes a family member used the same pads all over her face, neck, chest, and arms with no reaction at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or blemish-prone skin, report the pads caused no new breakouts and, in a few cases, helped calm existing blemishes. Two reviewers are strong outliers: one who says she is not normally acne-prone broke out in severe, painful cystic acne all over her face, and another broke out after about ten days of use despite never having dealt with acne before; a third saw no blemish improvement either way.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the pads absorb without leaving a greasy or oily residue, but a few with oily or combination-oily skin found the formula too rich for their skin type, leaving their face oilier the next day when used at night or generally too heavy to recommend for oily skin.

If I could give this 0 stars, I would

extraits.titre: I'm allergic but my sister isn't
extraits.texte: Unfortunately, my skin barrier has experienced acute damage. I have an acute allergic reaction to a specific ingredient, which has left my nerve endings completely exposed and hypersensitive. I was not rough with these extremely thin pads. I have sensitive skin naturally so this isn't for me. I did let my sister use it and she not only rubbed it all over her face like I had but she put it all m over her neck, chest and arms. she had no reaction to it.

i'm in my early 50s with dry skin. after using these (now on my 2nd package) my face is more plump and firm. forehead lines and 11 lines have diminished, marionette lines have diminished, neck lines are diminished. sometimes i use them twice a day, sometimes only once. there's a difference when i skip using these completely. the container does leak a bit if packed on a trip and not transported upright - solve this by transferring a stack of the pads into a ziploc. they stay moist and take up less space in your luggage. use as the first step after ckeansing as it is watery and does take a minute or two to dry. one pad covers the face and neck/upper chest easily. follow with other serums of increasingly thicker viscosity before moisturizer and sunscreen. while using these i haven't had any negative interactions with other products or reactions on my skin so they should be fine for anyone with skin sensitivity.

These pads have become a holy grail in my skincare routine! I have rosacea and combination skin, so my skin can get really dry at times. Ever since I started using these, they've helped retain moisture and leave my skin feeling noticeably more plump. I also have sensitive skin, and thankfully, I haven't experienced any irritation!

Wow, this product is truly amazing! I have dry skin that gets extremely dehydrated and loses elasticity in winter, but after using this product, my skin became incredibly moisturized and gained elasticity I didn't experience any blemishes at all, and the adherence is absolutely phenomenal It also works wonderfully as a makeup base There's honestly nothing to dislike about it. For me, it's a product I'm completely satisfied with

I've had a great experience using the Hwahae pads. They make my skin feel firm and elastic, and they're actually so sticky they cling to your fingers a bit. I'd recommend these for dry or combination skin types, but they might not be suitable for oily skin. The firming effect on the skin is only temporary. Of course, if you use it consistently for a very long time, your skin might change, but I don't think there's a compelling reason to use this product exclusively for an extended period. When I use it for night care, my skin becomes excessively oily the next day (combination dehydrated skin), so I prefer to use it as part of my Hwahae routine.
